motion_rule: the yard slides past her without a pause. She never works a prop in place: she rides, hauls, throws. Camera tracks her, new shot size every beat, never wider than a mid shot, her body half the frame. Movement across frame, never into depth. Laundry streams past every beat.
character: a slim grey turtle dove, pink breast, black neck ring, head stabbing the air
second_characters: ONE sparrow at the lens: rides past on a peg, snaps at her, never still; TWO crows in flat caps on her from 7.45, at the lens
props: ONE rolled banknote pegged among the sheets; ONE wooden peg carriage she rides; ONE fat leather wallet under her wing
prop_continuity: the banknote slides past her from 1.40 on; the wallet is under her wing till the crows rip it at 7.75
environment: a courtyard packed with washing lines, sheets, balconies, pigeons on the ledges
light_events: hard midday sun, sharp shadows racing across the white sheets

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints not spoken
audio.delivery: soft cooing female voice gone hard, preaching, biting each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ot-LO-zhish, CHOR-ny, pri-DYOT, CHOR-na-ya, DEN-gi, spa-SUT, TOL-ko, KRY-lya
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.75, 2.25-3.75 and 4.60-6.85 each one breath; after 6.85 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her beak opens wide and shapes every syllable
audio.sfx: wind, sheets cracking, the carriage squealing, crow caws, knives at 8.20

timeline.a: she runs the sagging wire, knocking pegs off with her beak, a wet sheet sweeping past behind
she hops on the peg carriage and it runs off down the wire, past window after window
the banknote slides the other way past her nose; she snaps at it and misses
the sparrow shoots past the lens on his own peg, she rides on
riding hard, she rears up and stabs her beak at the yard, a pillowcase banging past
the carriage hits a knot and throws her forward; she preaches on mid stumble
she snaps her head to profile as a bedsheet wipes across the frame behind her
she kicks the carriage at the sparrow, both tumble across frame, she catches the wire
she hauls herself along the wire toe over toe, the yard sliding by
she runs the top line at full stride, throat swollen, the sparrow racing her below
she drives through a row of pegs, they fly off, a sheet drops behind her
she rises on her toes at full stride, wings half up, the banknote sliding in close
she throws both wings wide and pushes off the wire, pegs scattering under her
she flies flat across the yard, sheets tearing past her wingtips
TWO crows cut in from both sides at the lens and rip the wallet from under her wing, she beats on
the two crows snap flick-knives at her across frame, blades raking her feathers, sparks bursting at the lens
she rolls out of the sparks and dives into the lens, wings hammering, beak snapping
she tears away across frame over the sheets, the two crows left holding the wallet

must_appear: she rides the peg carriage while preaching; at 7.75 the two crows rip the wallet from under her wing; knives and sparks at 8.20; at 8.80 she dives into the lens, alive and furious; she gets away
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, a horizontal frame, a wide shot, a parked camera, a bird working a prop in place, a closed beak while speaking, slow motion, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, blood, gore
